subject: Close-week alignment: budget window & approval path for Skyward Tech
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Close-week alignment: budget window & approval path for Skyward Tech

Hi Marta — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into the close week:

- What we heard: Skyward wants a small production pilot (MADP) focused on customer support routing and embeddings for your knowledge base; target latency <300ms; priority is cost predictability and strict data residency.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 1) pilot ingest 200k tokens/day, 2) SLA for latency/availability, 3) procurement sign-off on vendor security.

Proposed next steps (happy to adjust):
1) I will send a short SOW-style pilot plan and pricing estimate today (attached: Discovery-Notes-080426.pdf).
2) Can you confirm the budget window? Do you expect procurement/controller sign-off this quarter (week of Aug 24), or is approval likely to slip to the next cycle?
3) If budget stays for this quarter, suggested kickoff dates: Aug 30–Sep 3 for an initial two-week integration sprint.

Could you confirm stakeholders who need to be on approvals (legal, procurement, finance) and anyone I should loop in from Redwood for the security questionnaire? I’ve cc’d Lauren in case we want to accelerate an exec check-in.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the pilot plan and a brief HubSpot link to track steps.

—Priyom

We understand procurement is reviewing the security checklist; if the approval timeline will push the pilot into the next quarter, we can propose a scoped sandbox pilot that doesn’t require full procurement sign-off (limited data & infra) so you can validate product fit now and align budget later. If you prefer that route I can get options over to you by EOD.

Could you let us know today whether:
- Procurement will complete review by Friday?
- Legal/Finance need a demo or a short call to move faster?

On our side, Vivek is available for a short technical call today or tomorrow to answer any security/architecture questions.

Appreciate any update — we’re trying to be flexible with timelines and want to avoid missing the close-week window if this is still a priority.

Thanks,
